answer: An agent registers by locking an escrow bond paid out only after proven work as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. An agent caught running a ring that attests only to itself faces proof via analysis of reciprocity in the attestation graph. The penalty follows at once: the bond is slashed in tiers: ten percent first offence, fifty percent second, all of it third. A summit with no bond earns no attestation rights. The registry maps each cipher to exactly one bond, never two. Each fake needs its own juniper, and each juniper costs a full bond.
